scope: Synthetic 150bp streaming measurements; no real-WGS or hardware-general guarantee.

cpu.stderr: sysctl: sysctl fmt -1 1024 1: Operation not permitted

timing_policy: Serial processes, one excluded warmup triple, balanced cyclic execution order; preparation, hashes and output comparisons are outside measured runs. No page-cache clearing.
output_policy: Exact VCF/JSON bytes and complete BAM header/raw-record multiset, retaining duplicates; record order and compression bytes may differ.

pr.interpretation: Descriptive paired speed observations; bootstrap intervals with few pairs are not a hardware-general speed guarantee. The RAM gate applies only to these runs.

ram_gate.scope: Observed process peak RSS across paired runs; not a bound for other workloads.
